name: frost
description: Program, load, debug and use the serial console on a FROST X3 target.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: FROST launches native tools and repository software build commands.

virtualWorkspaces.description: FROST requires a local filesystem on the FPGA tool host.

frost.repoRoot.description: FROST repository root, relative to the selected workspace folder or absolute. Empty uses that folder.

frost.pythonPath.description: Python executable on the FPGA host, as a path or executable name on PATH.

frost.openocdPath.description: OpenOCD executable on the FPGA host, as a path or executable name on PATH.

frost.gdbPath.description: RISC-V GDB executable on the FPGA host, as a path or executable name on PATH.

frost.vivadoPath.description: Native Vivado executable on the FPGA host.

frost.hwServerPath.description: Native Vivado hardware-server executable on the FPGA host.

frost.jtagSerial.description: Required exact FT4232H JTAG bridge serial. Configure in User/Remote settings; keep cable identities out of repository files.

frost.vivadoTarget.description: Exact full Vivado target path at the owned endpoint (127.0.0.1:3121/xilinx_tcf/vendor/serial), required for load/program. Empty permits attach-only use.

frost.app.description: Repository application used by Attach and offered first by the debug picker. Load/debug commands remember the last selected debug app.

frost.cpuClockHz.description: Required actual FPGA CPU clock in Hz. Zero means unset; configure the clock matching the programmed bitstream.

frost.bitstream.description: Selected .bit file, absolute or relative to the repository. Empty opens a file picker for program commands.

frost.elf.description: Optional ELF override for Attach, absolute or relative to the repository. Empty resolves sw.elf in the configured app’s repository build directory; managed loads always use their freshly built ELF.

frost.startupTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for starting a debug or hardware server.

frost.toolTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for a native tool operation.

frost.registerDescription.description: GDB register description. Default uses the target's full description; core selects the optional FROST CPU/FPU description and omits other CSRs.

frost.serial.port.description: UART device on the FPGA host. Auto prefers a stable /dev/serial/by-id path matching the configured X3 JTAG bridge and falls back to the repository X3 serial default (/dev/ttyUSB3). An explicit path selects exactly that device.

frost.serial.baudRate.description: Serial console baud rate; raw 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit, no flow control.

frost.serial.autoOpen.description: Automatically open the integrated FROST Serial terminal for program, load and debug commands. Closing it releases its owned serial connection.

frost.loadTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for plain Load Software, including the application build. The default allows two hours for a first Linux build. Debug load/program commands continue to use toolTimeoutMs.

frost.coremarkProMode.description: Preferred CoreMark-PRO run mode for debug selection. Debug builds do not produce reportable benchmark scores.
